Class BrowserSessionReuse

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.driver.internal.BrowserSessionReuse
public final class BrowserSessionReuse extends Object
Keeps one browser per thread and test class when reuseBrowserSession=true. quit() resets browser state; the real quit happens when the class (or execution) finishes.
